{"id":2055938596,"question_id":4334,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 5 days","timestamp":1783178903,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"5 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2055938596/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Transform Binary String","memory":"30.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(string s1, string s2) {\n        int n = s1.size();\n        int cost = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(s1[i] == s2[i]) continue;\n            if(s2[i] == '1'){\n                s1[i] = '1';\n                cost++;\n            }\n            else if(s2[i] == '0')\n            {\n                if(i+1 < n and s1[i+1] == '1'){\n                    cost += (s1[i] == '1') ? 1 : 2;\n                    s1[i] = '0';\n                    s1[i+1] = '0';\n                }\n                else if(i+1 < n){\n                    cost += 2;\n                    s1[i] = '0';\n                    s1[i+1] = '0';\n                }\n                else if(i-1 >= 0){\n                    cost += 2;\n                    s1[i] = '0';\n                    s1[i-1] = s2[i-1];\n                }\n                else return -1;\n            }\n        }\n        return cost;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-transform-binary-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2296}
